acceptanceCriteria.text: `yohn-jp/.github#150` is completed and merged before implementation begins.
Every third-party `uses:` reference and material Node/pnpm/runtime/tool version in current Mottainai CI is inventoried and classified.
All stale external Actions are updated to the current provider-compatible approved revision, with immutable external pins and accurate version comments.

Compatible generic Node/pnpm setup/install mechanics consume the refreshed `yohn-jp/.github` authority from `@main`; redundant local implementations/direct setup paths are removed where semantics match.

Mottainai-specific integration, package/E2E, Runtime/Nix/VM/Appliance, host-bootstrap, release artifact lifecycle, and Review Pages trust/proof semantics remain local where they are genuinely product-specific.
Specialized local exceptions, including any install flags or release semantics not expressible by the shared contract, are retained only when necessary and documented in the PR.

CodeQL, governance, TypeScript baseline, publish, Review Pages, integration/package E2E, Runtime/Nix/VM/Appliance, and host-bootstrap paths are all explicitly covered by the audit rather than sampled selectively.
No duplicate CI execution or duplicate dependency installation is introduced.
Actual PR Actions prove every affected path, followed by a current-main full CI run after merge to prove no regression and record relevant critical-path/setup timings.
The PR records the final shared-versus-local authority matrix and the before/after dependency inventory.

issue.title: chore: audit and update all CI dependencies after shared provider refresh
